Comment.value: DESCRIPTION:
Generate a SaXML file and store it in a container field
The context upon exit will be a SaXML layout with a record where the xml file will be stored
This script is intended to be run via the Data API by a Bitbucket pipeline or a GitHub action; see https://bitbucket.org/soliantconsulting/saxml-delivery/src/main/
It can also be run directly by a full access user
When the file is hosted, the script creates a job record, starts the export via async PSoS, and returns right away with $data (jobStatus set to "running")

The caller then polls SaXMLDelivery::jobStatus (running | done | error) and SaXMLDelivery::jobMessage (error code and text when jobStatus = "error") on the SaXMLDeliveryExecutionContext layout, until jobStatus is no longer running
This async/polling approach keeps the initial Data API request short
If the file is not hosted, the export runs synchronously in the current session

Comment.value: MODE: this script runs in one of two modes, depending on whether a job record id was passed in:

Entry point ( not $isWorker ): called by the pipeline, a full access user, or a server schedule. Creates the job record. On a hosted file it hands the export off to a server session and returns right away; otherwise it does the export itself.
Worker ( $isWorker ): the server session started by the entry point. Finds the job record the entry point created, does the export, and records the outcome in jobStatus and jobMessage.
